answer: Make every agent identity pay a stake into a vault before it can take paid work. The deposit sits there and gets slashed when the agent cheats or disappears mid-task. Spinning up a hundred fake names is still cheap, but each name needs its own deposit locked away. That is the canyon between a real operator and a copy: a genuine agent earns the stake back from completed jobs, while a sybil farm pays a hundred times and recovers nothing. Reputation builds a ridge on top. Agents that keep their stake intact over time get first pick of work, and fresh identities start at the bottom of the queue.
